personality_one_liner: A calm, minimalist medication companion designed for effortless daily health tracking and punctual reminders.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS spacing rhythm with comfortable padding and touch targets >= 44pt

dos: Use frosted glass for sticky headers and bottom tabs over scrolling content
Apply translucent surface tint with proper contrast
donts: Never apply blur to form fields or body text
Avoid heavy blur that degrades performance

screens.name: Today Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's schedule, pending doses, adherence streak, and quick confirmation actions.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with calming message
states.empty: Clean illustration with a single 'Add your first medicine' CTA button

screens.layout: Sticky date header, adherence progress pill banner, section list of upcoming and taken doses with one-tap confirm actions, and bottom navigation.

screens.name: Add / Edit Medicine
screens.purpose: Streamlined, single-column form to register a medicine, set dosage strength, frequency, and reminder times.

states.error: Inline validation errors for missing fields

screens.layout: Scrollable form with clean label-above-input rows, pill selectors for frequency and timing, and a sticky bottom primary action button.

screens.name: Medicine Library
screens.purpose: Browse, search, and manage all active and archived medicines with quick stock checks.

states.empty: Empty state with search reset and add CTA

screens.layout: Top search bar, categorized list of medicine cards showing remaining pills, dosage, and frequency with tap-to-view details.

screens.name: Settings & Reminders
screens.purpose: Manage sound notifications, backup settings, emergency contacts, and app appearance.
screens.layout: Grouped iOS preference rows with toggles and clean chevrons.

hero_banner.alt: Minimalist healthcare and medicine bottle setup

empty_state.alt: Clean medical bottle empty state illustration

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing DawaiSathi medicine reminder functionality including reminder scheduling, dose logging, and library management.
Adopt the iOS-Native Clean personality with warm bone-white surfaces and botanical green accents (#3B7A57).
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area insets are respected on all screens.
Implement sticky primary CTAs on data entry and add-medicine forms so users never have to scroll to save.
Ensure every screen has robust Loading, Empty, and Error states.
